description: Shipping container number check: validates an ISO 6346 container number (owner code, category, serial, check digit, computed locally), names the owner of the prefix (e.g. MSKU = Maersk) with country and website from the public prefixlist.com register, and returns links to the owner's and track-trace.com's tracking pages. It does not read the container's live milestones (carriers publish them on their own sites). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

container.description: Container number: 4 letters + 7 digits, e.g. MSKU1234565 or MSKU 123456-5
